title: evidence prune --apply skips an eligible observation that holds an external artifact
symptom: prune --apply refuses or skips the set: the pre-removal recheck digests the external artifact as a project file and finds it missing
trigger: evidence prune --apply with an eligible old observation whose artifacts include an external one
expected: The record and its .chough/artifacts log are removed; the external file is never touched (REQ-cli-006)
actual: The observation is retained ('artifact is changed, missing or unsafe') or the apply aborts and restores
steps: Record an old routine run with an external artifact
chough consent grant retention; chough evidence prune --apply

notes.text: status: open -> verified. Passes once the prune recheck skips external IDs; found by dogfooding prune --apply.
